description: gitIgnoredAuthors: updpkgsums.yml (the checksums and .SRCINFO) and biome-migrate.yaml (the migrated biome.jsonc) commit to a Renovate branch as github-actions[bot]. Renovate checks both the author and the committer of every commit on its branch; without this, it takes such a commit for a manual edit, marks the pull request as edited and stops updating it.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints after a comment: `# datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>`. A trailing ! of a version pinned in .trunk/trunk.yaml is left out of the version.

The upstream version in a PKGBUILD: `pkgver=<version> # datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>`. It needs a regex of its own, as the generic one above would take `pkgver=` for a part of the version.
